title: Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council (Farsi): “One of the interesting points I thought to myself was that these people [regional countries’ officials] became more Hezbollahi [anti-Zionist] than many of our allies; they spoke so decisively against Israel. Mr. Emir Khaled [Prince Khalid bin Salman, Saudi Arabia’s defense minister] said that after you [Iran], they [Israel] will go after Türkiye, and then they will come after us, Saudi Arabia. Mr. Ibrahim Kalin, the head of Türkiye’s intelligence and security organizations, also spoke very intensely [about the same matter], and Mr. Asim Munir [Pakistan’s Chief of Defense Forces] also spoke about the Israeli threat and the bond being formed between Hindus and Jews against Muslims and even against Pakistan. These are statements based on intelligence and concerns they have regarding Israel’s future in relation to themselves
